recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Future itemWeight context changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack, and future calculated-score behavior or examples should be made in SDC unless FHIR-I explicitly moves them back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-15669 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Questionnaire request for STU3. It asked for answer-specific scores for instruments such as PHQ-9 and a way to display calculated totals; the approved resolution used ordinalValue on Questionnaire item options plus an Expression-based calculated-answer extension aligned with CQI.
initial_application: Jira comments cite SVN #14772. In git this is b8c5990ac5ad735ba1e8e836fd8a4c6fd3534a3e, whose subject explicitly names FHIR-15669 in a Questionnaire/QuestionnaireResponse change bundle that carried the then-current scoring and calculated-value approach into core.
additional_context: Later decisions refined the original representation: FHIR-16243 broadened scoring beyond coded answers; FHIR-24672 renamed ordinalValue to itemWeight; FHIR-15674 separately audited the calculated-values half and concluded current core should defer detailed machinery to SDC. The active itemWeight and retired ordinalValue definitions now live in the FHIR Extension Pack, while SDC defines calculatedExpression and examples/guidance for score calculation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, its notes already direct advanced calculated scores to SDC, and its math section already describes itemWeight on Questionnaire.item.answerOption including non-code option values. Core has no remaining exact ordinalValue extension-name residue requiring a source edit.
